name: Disk Space Monitor — Weekly Alert (Mac Mini)

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value:
Run these 3 commands and return the raw output of each, separated by a blank line:
1. df -h /
2. docker system df 2>/dev/null || echo 'Docker not available'
3. du -sh ~/.ollama/models 2>/dev/null || du -sh /opt/homebrew/var/ollama 2>/dev/null || echo 'Ollama models path not found'
Return only the command outputs, no commentary.
